notes.title: The Whittled Horse - DEMO Available Now!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

The team and I have been working very hard and are proud to release a demo for our upcoming game, The Whittled Horse!

In the demo you will experience the town of Newf. It is a peaceful place, with some odd and mysterious characters in it. You will also play the first biking section, an obstacle dodging mini-game that will act as a bridge between the towns you visit in the final game. And lastly, you will absorb dramatic cutscenes that set up the conflict for the remainder of the game.

If you play the demo and have any feedback, good or bad, please leave a review on the demo page or join our Discord and let us know!


The final game is set to launch in 2025, we have exciting things planned!

Until next time,
Isaac

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3264030/The_Whittled_Horse_Demo/]The Whittled Horse - DEMO[/url]

notes.title: Introducing The Whittled Horse - A Charming Adventure Game
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

I'm very excited to announce my team's new game The Whittled Horse!


We have been working very hard and are looking forward to releasing a demo this October (2024). The final game will be released early 2025.

There are a lot of amazing ideas and art in the pipeline for areas outside of what you'll see in the demo, and I can't wait to see how people react!


Please consider wishlisting to stay updated on news about the demo and the final game. Your support means the world to myself and the team.

Until next time,
Isaac

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3062450/The_Whittled_Horse/]The Whittled Horse - Steam Page[/url]

notes.title: Achievements in Scratch Man + New Game Incoming!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

It's almost been a year since I launched Scratch Man! I am very happy with the reception of the game and wanted to release an update to add additional features.

In the new version released today you'll see that there are now Steam Achievements for the game! There are 5 in total to achieve so if you're a new player I hope you have fun getting them! Or if you've played before I hope these make the game worth revisiting.

There are also minor changes in this update, such as tweaked graphics and a new title screen.


To close this post I wanted to announce I'm working on a new game! I'm working with some very talented people and am excited about what we're making. The Steam Page will be up soon!

Until next time,
Isaac
